text: Ha Tinh to build expressway connecting Ho Chi Minh Road to Cau Treo International Border Gate
The Ministry of Construction has assigned central Ha Tinh province to invest in an expressway section running from the Ho Chi Minh Road to Cau Treo International Border Gate.
The 51-km section is part of the Ha Tinh - Cau Treo expressway.
It is planned to have four lanes.
Total investment capital is estimated at VND15 trillion ($570 million).
The Ha Tinh-Cau Treo Expressway is projected to have a total planned length of approximately 85km, divided into two sections.
The first section, about 34km long, will connect the eastern North-South Expressway with Ho Chi Minh Road.
It is planned to have six lanes, beginning at an interchange with the North-South Expressway in Truong Luu Commune.
The second section will run approximately 51km from Ho Chi Minh Road to Cau Treo International Border Gate.
